report.clinical_summary: The patient presents with new symptoms (fatigue, night sweats, neck discomfort) that started two months ago, on a background of a five-year diagnosis of Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL) managed via 'watch and wait'. They are seeking answers to understand if these symptoms are related to their CLL or something else entirely. They express concern about the new symptoms and hope for guidance to regain a sense of control.

evidence.quote: The fatigue has also been getting worse over time
more tired when I've been sitting at the computer for a while
